summary.zh: 把旧 React 应用升级并改用 Hooks
summary.en: Upgrade React apps and move class components to hooks

description.zh: 升级 React 版本，把类组件改写为函数组件与 Hooks，并逐步接入并发特性。适合维护多年的 React 项目做现代化改造，或在升级过程中梳理兼容问题。
description.en: Upgrades React versions, converts class components to hooks, and adopts concurrent features step by step. Use it on long-lived React codebases that need modernizing without a full rewrite.
